profile.name: Ahmad Ilawa
profile.title: Frontend Engineer & Game Developer
profile.about: A passionate software engineer specializing in high-performance web systems and immersive game design. My journey began with a graduation project focused on Plant Disease Detection using Deep Learning (CNN), which bridged the gap between complex engineering and practical AI solutions. Now, I craft pixel-perfect React applications and build interactive worlds in Godot.

Assisted in building scalable enterprise solutions and optimizing frontend performance.
Intensive training in modern web development, focusing on MERN stack and team collaboration.
